meta.name: shopify
meta.description: Build Shopify applications, extensions, and themes using GraphQL/REST APIs, Shopify CLI, Polaris UI components, and Liquid templating. Capabilities include app development with OAuth authentication, checkout UI extensions for customizing checkout flow, admin UI extensions for dashboard integration, POS extensions for retail, theme development with Liquid, webhook management, billing API integration, product/order/customer management. Use when building Shopify apps, implementing checkout customizations, creating admin interfaces, developing themes, integrating payment processing, managing store data via APIs, or extending Shopify functionality.

copy.tagline: 构建 Shopify 应用、主题和扩展
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为 Shopify 店铺开发应用或自定义功能。
copy.tagline_en: Build Shopify apps, themes, and extensions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to develop apps or customize features for a Shopify store.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你开发 Shopify 应用、扩展和主题，包括使用 GraphQL/REST API 管理数据、用 Liquid 模板定制店铺前端、创建结账和管理后台 UI 扩展，以及处理 Webhook 和账单集成。
howto.when: 当你需要为 Shopify 店铺开发应用、自定义结账流程、创建管理后台界面、开发主题或通过 API 管理商品/订单/客户时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 Shopify 应用，包含结账 UI 扩展。
用 Liquid 写一个产品展示模板。
查询最近 10 个订单的 GraphQL 请求怎么写？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you develop Shopify apps, extensions, and themes, including using GraphQL/REST APIs to manage data, customizing storefronts with Liquid, creating checkout and admin UI extensions, and handling webhooks and billing integration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to build Shopify apps, customize checkout, create admin interfaces, develop themes, or manage store data via APIs.

say_en.text: Create a Shopify app with a checkout UI extension.
Write a Liquid template to display products.
say_en.note: Claude will provide Liquid code showing product images, titles, and prices.

say_en.text: How to query the last 10 orders using GraphQL?
say_en.note: Claude will provide a GraphQL query with pagination and required fields.
